overview: The Medford City Council met to review capital facility bonding and renovations for the high school pool, discuss public access station TV3 operations, and address resolutions on crosswalk maintenance, dog park planning, and taxi licenses.

items.title: Crosswalk Repainting and Resurfacing
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution directing the Department of Public Works to repaint crosswalks and evaluate road resurfacing along Medford Street and other intersections.

items.title: Dog Park Status and Advisory Committee
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting a status report on proposed dog park locations and mitigation funds, and calling for a resident advisory committee.

items.title: Channel 3 TV Access Broadcasting and Operations
items.summary: Debated public access TV3's relocation to Riverside Avenue and transmission setup, while a motion to request a city solicitor opinion on City Hall equipment liability failed.

items.title: Municipal Facilities, Capital Bonding, and High School Pool Renovations
items.summary: Adopted the Committee of the Whole report regarding Medford High School pool repairs and requested detailed financial bonding spreadsheets for upcoming DPW, police station, and pool capital projects.

items.title: Taxi Owner License Application for Citywide Taxi Inc.
items.summary: Approved a petition by Joseph O. Pierre of Citywide Taxi Inc. for two taxi owner licenses operating out of 40 Canal Street.

items.title: Taxi Operator License Application for Joseph F. Pierre
items.summary: Tabled a taxi operator license application for Joseph F. Pierre because the applicant was not present.

items.title: Reappointment of W. Warren Ramirez to Commission of Trust Funds
items.summary: Confirmed the mayor's reappointment of W. Warren Ramirez as Commissioner of Trust Funds.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Track Walking Hours
items.summary: Approved a resolution taken from the table requesting that the Hormel Stadium track be opened during morning hours for public walking.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the official records of the City Council meetings from May 14, 2013, and May 21, 2013.
